clinician.trajectory_summary: A 19-year-old Nigerian female presented with recurrent headache, fever, easy fatiguability, and breathlessness. Initial workup revealed severe anemia, leukopenia with relative lymphocytosis, and thrombocytopenia (PCV 10.8%, WBC 4.1×10^9/L, platelets 50×10^9/L). Peripheral blood smear showed immature mononuclear cells with cytoplasmic blebs and giant platelets suggestive of megakaryoblastic lineage. Bone marrow aspiration was a dry tap; imprint showed >90% immature mononuclear cells with pleomorphic nuclei and cytoplasmic blebs. Immunophenotyping of peripheral blood confirmed AML M7 with positivity for CD33, CD41, and CD61. Imaging revealed increased fibrosis in tibia and fibula. Induction chemotherapy with cytarabine and daunorubicin (7+3 regimen) was initiated. Repeat bone marrow aspiration on day 7 post-induction showed blast count less than 5%, indicating remission. Repeat FBC showed pancytopenia with no abnormal mononuclear cells. No further clinical follow-up or outcome details documented.
